column1: # Lamakan confrontation: Ash Jenna's origin, her offer, and Isaac's response.

column3: You came back.\nI wondered if you'd\nrecognize me.{end_wait}
I saw you before.\nYou look like Jenna.\nTell me who you are.{end_wait}
You kept going,\njust as I thought.\nI owe you an answer.{end_wait}
I know Jenna.\nYou have her face.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I'm Jenna. Not yours.
The beacons in my world
were all lit.{page_break}Then our home was gone.
The Wise One did nothing.
I was there to see it.{end_wait}
Why come to Isaac?\nWhat can he do\nthat you couldn't?{end_wait}

He gave you a task.
You're the one he may
be willing to hear.{page_break}I need to know why
my world was left to die.
Help me ask him.{end_wait}
It may be her truth.\nBut we only have\nher word for it.{end_wait}
If she's right,\nwe need to know.\nBut we need evidence.{end_wait}
You stayed for\nthose miners when we\ncould have moved on.{end_wait}
Help her question\nthe Wise One?{end_now}
I'll face him with you.\nBut I won't condemn\nhim without proof.{end_wait}
Then when the next\nbeacon burns, watch\nwhat changes.{end_wait}
Isaac, I want answers\ntoo. Just don't mistake\nher pain for proof.{end_wait}
Don't trust me blindly.\nJust remember what\nI asked you to notice.{end_wait}
No. I'll find out\nwhat happened first.\nThen I'll decide.{end_wait}
Then find your proof.\nI hope you can bear\nwhat you discover.{end_wait}
We can argue later.\nKalay is still ahead.{end_wait}
She may be wrong.\nThat doesn't mean\nwe shouldn't look.{end_wait}

Your Jenna and Kraden
are still with Menardi.
Felix travels with them.{page_break}The road goes to Kalay.
Go after your friends.
We'll speak again.{end_wait}
